notes.title: Early Access 1.2.0 is OUT!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Everyone![/h1]

In this update, we focused on improving some of the characters we felt were underwhelming. We also added many miscellaneous sound effects throughout the game. 
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Early Access 1.2.0 Update[/h2]

[h3]General Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Pause Menu interface has been completely overhauled. It has new visuals matching the style of the main menu and new functionalities.
[*]At every launch of the game, there is now a pop-up explaining how to use Steam Remote Play to play the game with your friends online.
[*]Added several new UI-Only Sound Effects.
[*]Added a new sound effect for powerup spawn and pickup.
[*]Before spawning onto the arena, each player will emit a light beam with their respective color on the spawn location. This serves as a cue to where your character will appear. 
[*]Kraken's Grasp map received a camera touch-up alongside some visual fixes to the water around it.
[/list]
[h3]Pyro & Cryo Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reworked all sound effects.
[*]Firestream is now much bigger and menacing. 
[*]Firestream Visual Effect has been completely overhauled along with a size increase to match the new hitbox.
[*]Thermal Shock, Pyro & Cryo's ultimate, received a visual effects overhaul. Mechanics unchanged.
[/list]
[h3]Lady Luck Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Her third spell, Suit Shuffle, has been replaced with Lucky Charm.
[*]Lucky Charm throws a heart projectile forward, upon impact it created a mark on the ground that explodes every 1 second 3 times before disappearing. It deals damage to both heroes and terrain.
[*]Suit Shuffle will be available on Ability Draft when the game mode releases.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
We're still hard at work on the interface improvements. Meanwhile, we hope to gather more feedback and keep updating the game weekly. 

Hope you guys enjoy the changes! Until next week!

notes.title: Early Access 1.1.0 is OUT!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Everyone![/h1]

Today we'd like to share the news regarding today's update and also let ya'll know what we're working on under the hood!
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Early Access 1.1.0 Update[/h2]
[list]
[*]Dragonleaf arena is now smaller.
[*]Fixed some decorations on Dragonleaf not properly casting their shadows.
[*]Fixed Roboto's ultimate inconsistently appearing on certain arenas (Visual fix mostly)
[*]Gang's Ultimate now auto-destroys itself if Gang dies while it is active. Fixed bugs related to it's dissapearing behavior. 
[*]Stunned players now always use the same VFX indicator above their heads.

Before, each spell had its own stun indicator that shared similar shape language, but this proved to be insufficient to indicate players they were stunned. All spells have been updated to use the same shared stun indicator for better clarity. 

Here is a GIF showcasing the new stun effect: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38713431/0d1506190e6afdb74d5f104f4d1238d9d73b8abb.gif[/img]
[/list][hr][/hr]
[h2]What are we working on?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38713431/c7f35c61c529e3f10e3637181b28ea9b4b6c5d2e.png[/img]

Currently, me and Willian are honing-in on interface changes. 

We are reworking the pause menu, and also ironing out concepts of how to handle loading screens, since as of now player just pop in and out of arenas without much of a transition.

We're also experimenting with how a reworked picking screen would look like, currently we're planning to split the screen into 4 parts, in such a way that makes it more obvious who is playing who.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38713431/6bde57b6ac96ecc46a80e0ecacb2ca770929cd22.png[/img]

We also want to make some cool UI-Space visual effects to add an extra punch to our announcement texts of "Round 1" or "Player X Wins".

We expect to have some more things to share next monday, along with a new update!

notes.title: Play Now!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

After 2 long years of development, we're proud to say that Fight N' Fall is finally among us! 

The game is releasing on early access, so some road bumps are expected, but we're looking forward to your feedback!

This development journey has been one hell of a ride, and we're happy to take this to the next step!

Thank you!

notes.title: Fight N' Fall Approaches!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Brace yourselves![/b][/h1]

On [b]November 26th[/b] the arenas of Fight N' Fall will open, and eyes turn to witness the battle between our heroes! 

Get a hefty discount with our early access release and join forces with us to guide the future of the game into its full release! Over [b]15 playable heroes[/b] await, across [b]11 arenas[/b] and [b]2 game modes[/b]... The battle begins!

[previewyoutube=tGrb0vYG5mo;full][/previewyoutube]

We plan to use early access as a tool to make the game the better version it can be! We also plan on releasing one update post going through the flux of development every Monday from now on, so we can keep ya'll up to date on the latest news. 

Please consider purchasing the game on the 26th to support the development and also to have some fast-paced fun! 

I'll see you on the battlefield!
